{{disambig|Mystery}}

==Enemies==
'''Mystery''' may refer to these enemies:
*[[Frost Mystery]], an enemy that spawns random enemies upon death, that first appears on Wave 9 in [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode, and on Wave 18 on Easy difficulty and Wave 23 on Hard difficulty in [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)]]
**[[Frost Mystery/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Mega Frost Mystery]], an enemy that spawns random enemies upon death, that first appears on Wave 25 in [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode
**[[Mega Frost Mystery/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Mystery]], an enemy that summons a random enemy upon death, it appears on Wave 17 in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode and Wave 16 in [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode
**[[Mystery/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Elite Mystery]], an enemy that summons a random enemy upon death, it appears on Wave 32 in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode and Wave 33 in [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode
**[[Mystery Boss/Advanced Stats]]

It can also refer to these removed enemies:
*[[Super Mystery]], an enemy that summoned a random enemy upon death, which first appeared on Wave 32 in [[Easy Mode|Beginner's]] and [[Molten Mode|Molten]] modes
*[[Uber Mystery]], an enemy that summoned a random enemy upon death, which first appeared on Wave 32 in [[Golden Mode|Golden]] and [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] modes
*[[Ultra Mystery]], an enemy that summoned a random enemy upon death, which first appeared on Wave 16 in [[Golden Mode|Golden]] and [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] modes
*[[Mystery Summoner]], a summoner enemy which first appeared on Wave 36 in [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode
*[[Mystery Boss]], an enemy that summons a random enemy upon death depending on what Wave it is, it appears on Wave 33 in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode
**[[Mystery Boss/Advanced Stats]]

It can also refer to these event enemies:
*[[Frost Mystery (Frost Invasion)]], an enemy that summoned a random enemy upon death, which first appeared on Wave 8 in [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)]]

It can also refer to these exclusive enemies:
*[[Golden Mystery]], an exclusive enemy that spawns every modern enemy upon death.
